evidence: The film thickness measurements were conducted by spectroscopic ellipsometry (SE, Ellipso Technology, UV-FM8). The atomic concentrations were determined by Auger electron spectroscopy (AES, PHI700Xi) depth profiles. X-ray diffraction (XRD, smartlab) was done to examine the microstructure of the ATO layers, based on the conventional theta - 2 theta scanning method (Cu K α source). Hall measurements (Ecopia) were carried out to collect information on the electrical characteristics (carrier type, carrier concentration, conductivity and Hall mobility). The optical bandgaps of the Al-SnO X films were determined by UV – visible absorption spectroscopy (UV 3600, Shimadzu). A homemade equipment was used to measure the Seebeck coefficients.
